findings.description: The sleep call executes without checking if it is the final attempt. This causes an unnecessary delay after the last failed call and violates the negative constraint in the specification.
findings.evidence: When operation() raises TransientError on every call (or attempts=1), line 12 executes sleep(base_delay * 2 ** attempt) for the last iteration before the loop ends. SPEC.md states: 'Never sleep after the final failed call: re-raise that last TransientError immediately.'

review.summary: candidate.py unconditionally sleeps after every TransientError, including the final failed attempt, violating the explicit contract to never sleep after the last failure.
